graph.title: The Batman Tumbler
notes: Only 15 numbered steps are shown as small pictures, and several steps (especially 5, 7, 11, 12 and 13) add pieces without a readable parts box. The placement of those pieces (slopes, wedges, 3023 plates, jumpers, round plates, 3700 bricks) is inferred from the inventory and the final pictures. Treat those joins as approximate.

Chassis layout is an assumption. Two 1x8 plates (b1, b2) sit at the bottom, and a second pair (b4, b5) sits on top and is offset two studs forward. The front wheel-holder plate b6 is clipped under that overhang, and b3 (6157) sits on the rear studs.
Only one representative stud/anti-stud port pair is listed for each pair of connected pieces, even where several studs engage.
Wheel and tyre joins, and the joins of the wheel holders b3 and b6, use null ports. The assumed pairings are 6014b with 56890 at the rear and 74967 with 30028 at the front.
The 2412b grille, the extra tan plates and the 2654 boat stud (underside) are placed from the final pictures.
The 2540 side-handle plates carry the black flags 44676 (clip on bar) in step 15. The catalogue gives 2540 only one bar port, so both flag clips are joined to bar.1.
